entities.summary: Odette Nyiramilimo is a Rwandan physician and politician. She served as Minister of State for Social Affairs in the government of Paul Kagame from March 2000 to October 2003, a member of the Rwandan Senate from 2003 to 2008, and was a member of the East African Legislative Assembly for one term, from 2012 to 2017.
